note: File Download Link is a single field formatter plugin, 'file_download_link', for file and image field types. It renders each file as a download link with settings link_text (default 'Download'), link_title, aria_label, new_tab (default TRUE), rel_attribute, force_download (default TRUE, adds the HTML5 download attribute), force_download_filename, custom_classes; schema field.formatter.settings.file_download_link. No configure route (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush. Token support activates when the token module is enabled. Configured on a field's Manage display, stored at core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> content.<field>. Introspection reads a live display's formatter + link_text; execution switches a field's formatter to file_download_link and changes its link_text, verified against the live entity_view_display. All cases use a namespaced field (field_fdl_*) on the Article content type.

evals.prompt: What does the file_download_link module provide, and which field types can it be used on?
evals.expected_output: It provides a single field formatter, 'file_download_link' ('File Download Link'), usable on file and image field types, that renders each file as a configurable download link. Set it on a field's Manage display; there is no admin/config page.

evals.prompt: How do I make the file_download_link formatter force the browser to download the file rather than open it, and what is the default link text?
evals.expected_output: Enable the 'force_download' setting (default on), which adds the HTML5 download attribute to the link; optionally set force_download_filename for a specific filename. The default link text is 'Download' (empty falls back to the filename).

evals.prompt: Can the file_download_link link text include dynamic values like the file size, and what does that require? Which settings does it apply to?
evals.expected_output: Yes, when the Token module is enabled the link_text, link_title, aria_label, force_download_filename and custom_classes are passed through Token::replace() with the file and host entity as data (e.g. '[node:field:description] ([file:size])'); the field delta is inserted automatically for multi-value fields.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a file field displayed with the file_download_link formatter and a custom link text. Inspect the live default display and state the configured link text.
On this Drupal site, inspect the Article content type's default display for the file field named field_fdl_probe and state which field formatter renders it.
evals.expected_output: field_fdl_probe is rendered with the file_download_link formatter (component type = file_download_link in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a file field 'field_fdl_task' currently shown with the default file formatter. Using the file_download_link module, change its default display so the field renders as a File Download Link. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_fdl_task component type is set to 'file_download_link' (via Manage display, or setComponent on the entity_view_display).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article field 'field_fdl_link' is already displayed with the File Download Link formatter. Change its link text to 'Download PDF' and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The field_fdl_link component keeps type file_download_link and its settings.link_text is set to 'Download PDF' in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default.
